findings.title: JPQL built by concatenating the status parameter
findings.rationale: The status value is concatenated into the query text instead of bound as a parameter.
findings.failure_scenario: A status value containing a quote changes the query and returns or changes rows outside the request.

findings.title: @Transactional on cancel is bypassed by self-invocation
findings.rationale: cancelAll is not transactional and calls cancel through this, so the proxy never starts a transaction and the status change is not flushed.

findings.title: Refund failures are swallowed
findings.rationale: The catch block discards the exception, so a failed refund is reported as success.

input.summary: Three issues: JPQL concatenation, a bypassed transaction and a swallowed exception.
